## LTX-2.3 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Visual Details**: Describe all visual details you want to appear in the video  
3. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

怎么写视频提示词

截图发给豆包同时发送以下的提示词

这张图为首帧图的视频提示词，7秒时间，主要展现(这个你描述个大概)。一个要求，就是什么时间秒做什么内容，不用一秒一秒来，安装内容动作来规划。给我给现在这张图的英文视频提示词，要英文提示词，一整段不分段

A young woman, with her back to the camera, rapidly bends forward into a prone position in the first second, her feet rising sharply with the soles of her shoes facing the camera. In the second to third seconds, she flies backward at supersonic speed, passing through a misty canyon. In the fourth to fifth seconds, the camera closely follows the girl, the surrounding mountain walls rushing past, creating a sense of high-speed impact. In the sixth second, after a slight descent from her prone position onto the river surface, she surges upward again, soaring above the clouds, flying a great distance before bursting out of the valley to reveal a vast plain. The powerful sounds of air currents and flowing water complete this short but spectacular five-second video, showcasing exceptional directorial vision and cinematic skill.
